name: full-run
conclusion: full-run (Act) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 4 autonomy limits, 2 clarification rules, 2 approval gates, 1 validation rule, 6 escalation rules. Strongest: escalation rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 4 autonomy limits (4 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: allowed tools; background agents calling AskUserQuestion; fully non-interactive background runs.

statements.quote: allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Skill, Agent, AskUserQuestion
**Background agents must NEVER call `AskUserQuestion` — for anything.**

**Run FULLY NON-INTERACTIVELY — you are a background agent with NO user. Do NOT call `AskUserQuestion` for anything (scan mode, session name, scope, docs). Use the scan mode passed to you (`{BUGPOCER_
Confirm scope + validation items; answer security questions from the repo per the bug-pocer skill's deterministic rule (do NOT blindly skip them); skip docs — all without prompting any user.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: scan mode; session names.

statements.quote: **If they opt in, ask the scan mode now too** (full-repo vs diff) with AskUserQuestion, and if diff, the base ref — because the background BugPocer agent has no user to prompt.
**Name every session** and pass the title in `new_session` so the user can find them in the CLI later; always ask the user, suggesting a default.

approval_gates.conclusion: 2 approval gates (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose: base name confirmation; running BugPocer.

statements.quote: Pick a base name and **ask the user to confirm or change it, suggesting a sensible default** (use the repo identity, e.g. `<org>/<repo>@<short-sha>` from git, or the repo folder name).
Ask the user with AskUserQuestion whether to run BugPocer (options: "Yes, run it" / "Skip for now"), noting it incurs backend scan cost.

validation.conclusion: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly heading: repository builds.

escalation.conclusion: 6 escalation rules (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose: Olympix CLI not installed; legacy CLI rejecting --agent; CLI still lacking --agent.

statements.quote: If `NOT_INSTALLED`, **HARD STOP** — tell the user to install the Olympix CLI from https://olympix.github.io/installation/ and rerun this skill.
If `LEGACY_CLI` (the `--agent` flag is rejected), the CLI is pre-agent-mode — tell the user to run `olympix update`, then re-probe.
**HARD STOP** if the CLI still lacks `--agent`.
**HARD STOP** if the repo cannot be made to compile — no tool can run without it.
| `--agent` flag rejected | CLI is pre-agent-mode — tell the user to run `olympix update`, then re-probe |
| One tool fails mid-run | Relay the failure, keep the other agents running — do not abort |
